# Five dual-theme examples open dark when the catalog asks for light

## Context

Emmy's real-opening census for #21942 (A2A to Ada, 23 Nov 01:28Z) found five examples that configure both Neo themes but open on Neo Dark when their catalog link names `neo-theme-neo-light`. Her scratch run then confirmed that the ordinary resolver fixes all five fresh light launches (01:48Z). She is not claiming the build; the operator steered her to Workbench work.

## The Problem

A visitor in the light Portal opens Breadcrumb Toolbar, Context Menu (files), Multi-Step Account Form, Dock Perspectives and Pop-outs, or Dock Pane Pop-out, and lands on a dark page. Each `neo-config.json` lists `["neo-theme-neo-dark", "neo-theme-neo-light"]`. Each `app.mjs` passes a bare `mainView` class, so `?theme=` never reaches the view, which opens on `themes[0]`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/util/Theme.mjs#resolveStartTheme(config)` implements #21835's start rule: the `?theme=` theme when configured, else Neo Dark when the browser prefers dark and it is configured, else `themes[0]`. About sixty `app.mjs` files already pass `mainView: {module, theme: resolveStartTheme(...)}` (#21953, #21979).
- On a SharedWorker app, `Neo.config` is the first window's. The booting window's config is `Neo.windowConfigs?.[Neo.bootingWindowId]`, as `examples/dashboard/choreography/app.mjs` reads it (#21979). The two dock examples set `"useSharedWorkers": true`.
- #21975's Out of Scope keeps a single engine default waiting for #21973, so the per-example line is the current policy.

## The Fix

- `examples/toolbar/breadcrumb/app.mjs`, `examples/menu/contextFiles/app.mjs`, `apps/form/app.mjs`: `mainView: {module: …, theme: resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)}`.
- `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/app.mjs`, `examples/dashboard/tearOut/app.mjs`: the same, with `resolveStartTheme(Neo.windowConfigs?.[Neo.bootingWindowId] || Neo.config)`.
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs`: each of the five opens on Neo Light from a light request and on Neo Dark from a dark one.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Each of the five opens on `neo-theme-neo-light` from `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` and on `neo-theme-neo-dark` from `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark`, measured on the root viewport, with a browser spec red on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-2: The two dock examples read the booting window's request, so a reload in the same browser context still follows its own `?theme=`.
- [ ] AC-3: Theme toggles and child-window propagation in `StandaloneExamplesThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` stay green.

## Out of Scope

- A second, independent main tab of a dock example copying the first tab's palette through sibling sync; Emmy measured it and keeps it under #21942.
- An engine default for every example (#21975, #21973).
